evidence.title: 御製上下天光詩（圓明園四十景詩）
evidence.excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製上下天光詩
垂虹駕湖蜿蜒百尺修欄夾翼中為廣亭縠紋倒影滉瀁楣檻間凌空俯瞰一碧萬頃不啻胸吞雲夢
上下天水一色水天上下相連河伯夙朝玉闕渾忘望若昔年
evidence.summary: A long bridge of about a hundred chi crosses the lake between railings, with a broad pavilion in the middle. Ripples reflect on the lintels, and from above the green water seems endless, wider than the marshes of Yunmeng.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 上下天光
evidence.excerpt_zh: 慈雲普䕶之西臨湖有樓上下各三楹為上下天光左右各有六方亭後為平安院（圓明園冊）臣等謹按上下天光四十景之一也額為皇上御書聨曰雲水澄鮮一㡧波光開罨畫煙嵐杳藹四圍山色浸分奩亦御書右六方亭額曰飲和及平安院額皆世宗御書左六方亭額曰竒賞皇上御書
evidence.summary: West of 慈雲普䕶 on the lake: a tower of three bays on two floors called 上下天光, a six-sided pavilion on each side (飲和, 竒賞), and 平安院 behind.

evidence.title: 上下天光
evidence.locator: v2 p.20, under 上下天光; source ref 2-683
evidence.excerpt_zh: 垂虹架湖，蜿蜒百尺。修栏夹翼，中为广亭。縠纹倒影，滉漾楣槛间。凌空俯瞰，一碧万顷，不啻胸吞云梦。上下天水一色，水天上下相连。河伯夙朝玉阙，浑忘望若昔年。
evidence.summary: Poem 上下天光 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1744, filed by the editors under 上下天光.

evidence.title: 上下天光: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.152 item (1), under 上下天光
evidence.excerpt_zh: 碧彻澄空敞，清光印水宽。风迥叠绿绮，日射漾金澜。波阔虚奁展，尘消明镜观。安心欲如是，鉴物得其端。”此景名取自范仲淹《岳阳楼记》“上下天光，一碧万顷”句。乾隆九年（1744）御制“上下天光”诗云：“上下水天一色，水天上下相连。河伯夙朝玉阙，浑忘望若昔年。”诗序曰：“垂虹驾湖，蜿蜒百尺，修栏夹翼，中为广亭。縠纹倒影，滉漾楣槛间。凌空俯瞰，一碧万顷，不啻胸吞云梦。”北宋庆历四年（1044）的春天，范仲淹受朋友的嘱托为重修的岳阳楼写一篇纪念文章，这就是千古传诵的名篇《岳阳楼记》。在文章中，范仲淹看到洞庭湖波澜壮阔、横无际涯的壮观景象，便写下“上下天光，一碧万顷”的文字，来表达洞庭湖水天相接的辽阔胜景。圆明园上下天光是一处临水园林景观，通过这一景名，清帝将后湖比作洞庭湖，以一种抽象化、文学化的方式来表现后湖的壮美。当此美景，范仲淹想到“先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 上下天光, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 上下天光
evidence.locator: v2 p.20, under 上下天光; source ref 1-324
evidence.excerpt_zh: 碧彻澄空敞，清光印水宽。风回叠绿绮，日射漾金澜。波阔虚奁展，尘消明镜观。安心欲如是，鉴物得其端。
evidence.summary: Poem 上下天光 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 上下天光.

evidence.title: 上下天光: 道光八年 poem of the Daoguang Emperor
evidence.date: 道光八年 (1828), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.152 item (2), under 上下天光
evidence.excerpt_zh:
高楼明暖喜春阳，一鉴澄
清上下光。午荫迟迟度危槛，和暄景象正舒长。雨水节过暖不遥，山腰积雪未全消。园中花事如相约，转瞬杨枝拂小桥。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Daoguang Emperor at 上下天光, 1828, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 上下天光: 咸丰六年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
evidence.date: 咸丰六年 (1856), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.153 item (10), under 上下天光
evidence.excerpt_zh: 平湖鶔望夏如秋，竟日滂沱酒未休。烟色四园迷远岸，泉声万斛泻高楼。云飞南浦情无极，帘卷西山句好酬。千里阴睛虽有异，久征将士使子愁。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 上下天光, 1856, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: Scene 8, 上下天光 Shangxia Tianguang, Island of the Zig-zag Bridges
evidence.excerpt_other: The main building was built on piles over the water, by which the name is explained. Long zig-zag bridges extended east and west from this building.
evidence.summary: Main building on piles over the water; long zigzag bridges east and west; a hexagonal pavilion on the eastern bridge, a three-bay pavilion on the bridge to the next island west.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: remains tidied up
evidence.summary: A blogger's table of what was then visible. These scenes have building remains that have been cleared and tidied. Dated about 2011, so digs since then are not reflected.

evidence.title: 圆明园景点建筑命名对古代文学遗产的继承与发展
evidence.summary: How scene and hall names come from literature: 上下天光 from 范仲淹, 杏花春馆 from 杜牧, 武陵春色 from 陶渊明, 坐石临流 from 兰亭, and 丰乐轩 and 顺木天 from 柳宗元. It also quotes the 陶渊明 line 平畴交远风. It places 丰乐轩, three bays facing north, in the 紫碧山房 scene.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 上下天光
evidence.locator: from p.152, under 上下天光
evidence.summary: 上下天光: 10 dated items, 1798-1856, of which 10 poems (Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, snow, boating. First dated 1798, last dated 1856.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 上下天光
evidence.summary: Finished 1726: a two-storey three-bay open tower on the lake with a terrace and bent bridges carrying two hexagonal pavilions, 饮和 and 奇赏. By Daoguang's reign the bridges and 平安院 seem gone and a three-bay hall 心镜澄观 was added.

evidence.title: 样式雷烫样 of the Tongzhi repair of Yuanming Yuan (list by site)
evidence.date: 同治 (1873-74) for most, per the report
evidence.locator: Lei family models, now chiefly 故宫博物院; the report does not give numbers
evidence.summary: The Lei family card models cover Yuanming Yuan, Wanchun Yuan, the Summer Palace and others; most of the Yuanming Yuan ones were made for Tongzhi's repair: the whole central (九洲清晏) axis, 泉石自娱, 同乐堂, 上下天光, 思顺堂, 天地一家春; in the north 恒春堂, 课农轩, 廓然大公; in the south 勤政殿; in the west 万方安和. Period objects of 1873-74, not of 1860: they show the Tongzhi design, which kept many old names but changed forms.

evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析
evidence.summary: Dates three NLC Yangshi Lei water-course plans (about 1:2000) by the changes they show. It lists dated works: 1803 channel from 宁和镇 to 秀清村; 1810 镜远洲 at 平湖秋月; 1811 恒春堂; after 1828 清晖阁 replaced by 湛静斋; 1831 慎德堂; 1836 九州清晏殿 reduced to five bays with 同道堂 added west; 1846 洞天深处 four courts to two.

evidence.title: 上下天光区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12739, free part
evidence.summary: The report's opening gives 10,500 m2 of site and 1,600 m2 of buildings. Early Yongzheng had only the two-storey tower and a timber bridge pavilion; under Daoguang the upper floor was closed in and a square pavilion, a service court and an open hall were added. Tower and terrace 29.97 x 18.69 m, upper bays 8.64 m wide.

reconstructions.title: 上下天光 reconstruction: 如意桥 railing and the two pavilions
reconstructions.creator: 贺艳 and team
reconstructions.archive: 数字圆明园 team, as the report states
reconstructions.why: First modelled from the 四十景图 as asymmetrical; revised after the excavation found two identical, symmetrically placed piled foundations, and an archive of the 乾隆 reign saying two hexagonal pavilions. 番草抱叶 railing inferred from furniture in the Palace Museum.

reconstructions.title: 《“再造”一个圆明园》, Tsinghua news
reconstructions.creator: 郭黛姮, 贺艳 and team
reconstructions.archive: 清华大学; 清城睿现
reconstructions.why: 郭黛姮's research from 2000 with students including 贺艳; the digital work from 2009 by 清城睿现. They traced remains by bicycle: steps at 上下天光, cave and rockery at 杏花春馆, timber piles at 濂溪乐处. A clear account of method, without pictures to take.

reconstructions.title: Abb. 7-10, 上下天光 Shangxia Tianguang (Szene 108) on a Lei drawing of 1827, the Lei map, Gong Wu Ju map, He map
reconstructions.creator: Shuang Zhang
reconstructions.why: Same scene compared across four maps. He map shows the state of 1744 as in the silk painting; Lei map shows other buildings, she reads a rebuilding, backed by the Gong Wu Ju map and some Lei drawings.

reconstructions.title: 样式雷烫样 Yangshi Lei card models of Yuanmingyuan: 泉石自娱, 同乐堂, 上下天光, 思顺堂, 天地一家春, 恒春堂, 课农轩, 廓然大公, 勤政殿, 万方安和

reconstructions.why: Period models: most were made for the Tongzhi repair of about 1873, so they show a planned state after 1860, not the state in 1860.
reconstructions.caveat: Made for the repair of 1873–74, so later than the state of 1860: a period model, not a modern one.
